review_method: Plaintext source, independent diffs, metadata, source hashes and existing test receipts only; no scientific execution or numerical payload reads.

observed_failure.known_error: ValueError: Original campaign resource checker required

findings: Both actions require the exact independently approved operational source and current v3 release.
Authentication restricts work to the exact failed, reaped attempt6 identity, v2 wrapper, known pre-restore error, absent original PID/session, and absent native output.
Prepare preserves the complete original268 capture and builds the v3 successor from the same captured transition and preserved history; six original resource/scope/GPU fields are checked unchanged.
Only the ordinary nonsymlink failed outer output below4MiB is archived. Exclusive manifests retain its files and hashes, and source hashes are checked after same-filesystem rename.
State is reauthenticated immediately before the archive rename. Original captured history/archive is neither modified nor replaced.

Reset scope is limited to currently blocked transitive dependents with absent outputs. Real repairs._prepare validates plan revision, attempts, replacements, output accounting and archive manifest before one atomic sidecar publication.
Submit rebuilds and compares the exact replacement, refuses an existing dispatch body or pending sidecar, and contains no signals, controller restart or direct state mutation.
limitations: No synthetic full recovery run was requested or performed by this reviewer; review covers the exact narrow source and independently observed failure state.
If preparation or submission delivery is uncertain, inspect recorded files and controller state rather than retrying blindly.
Passing review does not claim production has resumed training.
